title: Gideon and the Cover
author: Wendell Montrose
blurb: Edmund Fairweather, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
